title: Auth hardening: device security, 2FA, passkeys & email verification
changes: Add a per-device sign-in / sign-up abuse throttle keyed by FingerprintJS visitorId, not IP
Add new-device sign-in alerts — email the user and every admin the first time an account is seen on a device, plus a New devices admin card with one-click session revoke
Add multi-account / trial-abuse detection — a Shared devices admin card flags any device fingerprint shared by 3+ accounts, each linked for a ban
Add TOTP two-factor auth via better-auth's twoFactor plugin — QR-code setup, encrypted backup codes, and enable/disable/regenerate from the Settings page
Add a /login/2fa code challenge for password sign-ins on 2FA-enabled accounts, with a 30-day "trust this device" option and backup-code fallback
Add passkeys (WebAuthn) via better-auth's passkey plugin — register/remove credentials in Settings and a passwordless "Sign in with a passkey" button on the login page
Email the account owner (device / location / IP / time) whenever a passkey is registered or deleted, mirrored to the activity log as passkey_added / passkey_removed

Add self-serve email verification — better-auth emailVerification config, a Verify email button on the dashboard Account Details card, Resend-delivered React Email template; stays opt-in (requireEmailVerification: false)
Add APP_NAME env var — drives the 2FA issuer label and passkey rpName instead of the hardcoded "Next.js Template"
Schema: new twoFactor and passkey tables, user.twoFactorEnabled, and passkey_added / passkey_removed activity_actions values (migrations 0013-0014)
